observations.workflow_yaml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, qa/exhaustive-suite-module-01, qa/syntax-audit-in625-a1]
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'qa/certification/continuity.json'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'qa/certification/continuity.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh install
      - name: Vendor deepmerge patch regressions
        run: node --test vendor/deepmerge/test/prototype-poisoning.node-test.cjs
      - name: QA dependency audit (hard gate)
        run: npm audit --package-lock-only --json > npm-audit.json
      - name: Upload npm audit report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: lite-npm-audit
          path: npm-audit.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Typecheck
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh typecheck
      - name: Unit and parity tests
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh test
      - name: Production build
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh build
      - name: Upload production build
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: lite-dist
          path: dist
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

name: IN625 Cumulative Certification Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [qa/syntax-audit-in625-a1]
    paths:
      - '**'
      - '!**/*.md'
      - '!qa/certification/continuity.json'
      - 'qa/certification/EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SG28_DISTRIBUTED_ACCEPTANCE.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SY_P_23_CONVENTION.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SY_X_04_LENGTH_CONTRACT.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SY_X_04_LENGTH_DECISION.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SG28_INTEGRATION_EXIT_CRITERIA.md'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**'
      - '!**/*.md'
      - '!qa/certification/continuity.json'
      - 'qa/certification/EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SG28_DISTRIBUTED_ACCEPTANCE.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SY_P_23_CONVENTION.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SY_X_04_LENGTH_CONTRACT.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SY_X_04_LENGTH_DECISION.md'
      - 'qa/certification/SG28_INTEGRATION_EXIT_CRITERIA.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reason:
        description: 'Reason for revalidating this SHA (recorded in the guard log)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  cumulative:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Reuse only verified evidence for this checkout
        id: certification_guard
        working-directory: .
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REVALIDATION_REASON: ${{ inputs.reason }}
        run: python3 scripts/certification/ci_guard.py --profile lite-cumulative
      - name: Validate original Algebra114 fixture integrity
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        working-directory: .
        run: python3 qa/certification/check_algebra114_fixture.py
      - name: Certification continuity and CI guard regressions
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        working-directory: .
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/certification -p 'test_*.py'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh install
      - name: Typecheck
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh typecheck
      - name: Unit and parity regression
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh test
      - name: Production build
        if: steps.certification_guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bash scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh build

steps.name: Reuse only verified evidence for this checkout

observations.workflow_yaml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, qa/exhaustive-suite-module-01, qa/syntax-audit-in625-a1]
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'qa/certification/continuity.json'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'qa/certification/continuity.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The 2026-11-12 EC-H-07 runs were cancelled at the 15-minute ceiling twice
    # while the same 2,973-test suite finished in 10:56 inside the Cumulative
    # gate. Extend only the wall-clock ceiling; test selection, coverage
    # threshold (75%) and every assertion remain unchanged.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CORS_ORIGINS: https://security-test.example
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            backend/requirements.txt
            backend/requirements-qa.txt
      - name: Install backend dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-qa.txt pytest-cov
      - name: Backend tests
        run: pytest -q --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=75 --disable-warnings

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bash ../scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh install
      - name: QA dependency audit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm audit --audit-level=moderate
      - name: Typecheck
        run: bash ../scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh typecheck
      - name: Unit and parity tests
        run: bash ../scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh test
      - name: Production build
        run: bash ../scripts/certification/frontend-runner.sh build
      - name: Upload production build
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: plus-frontend-dist
          path: frontend/dist
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
